description: Figure 16 is a grouped bar chart illustrating the average Shapley values for three multilingual BERT models—mBERT (light blue), XLM-R (dark blue), and chLSTM (light green)—across seven relative positions to a probed target word, labeled along the horizontal axis as L4+, L3, L2, L1, T, R1, R2, R3, and R4+. The vertical axis, labeled “Shapley value,” is scaled linearly from 0 to 80, with major gridlines and tick marks at intervals of 20. Each position on the horizontal axis has three adjacent bars, one for each model, showing their respective average Shapley values. The tallest bar is for chLSTM at position T, reaching approximately 80, followed by mBERT and XLM-R at the same position, both around 60. The other positions show much lower values, generally below 10, with the exception of L1, where all three models have values around 15. The bars are not sorted; they are presented in the order of the relative positions. There are no visual annotations or emphasis on specific bars beyond their color-coded representation in the legend.
